integrity: Analytical limiting proof with finite checks used for reproducibility, not as infinite-dimensional certificates; prior finite-domain Laplace/CDF input and the standard large-deviation method are credited.
limitations: Irreversible boundary-flip sector, equally spaced plus seeds, deterministic equal minus-domain lengths, independent site clocks, and log(m)/n tending to a strictly positive finite constant. No finite-amplitude reversibility, centered extreme distribution, or heterogeneous-gap result is asserted.
title: A sharp terminal-bottleneck transition in the extinction of logarithmic Ising domains
